listing.name: Quake II (Yamagi Quake II)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official Yamagi Windows 8.70a binary archive, or upstream 8.70 source build; own original Quake II data and separately selected expansion data/code. Limits: Official README describes mature enhanced client and addon repositories. GitHub Releases empty; official distribution site and expansion package handling need follow-up. Upstream platforms: Official Windows8.70a binary download and Linux/BSD source builds; code is64-bit clean but selected Windows artifact CPU unknown in frozen web page. macOS is community-supported. Original data: GitHub Releases empty; official distribution site and expansion package handling need follow-up. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
